newsitem.title: USA: Information Management names new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Information Management names new CEO.

text.p: Information Managment Technologies Corp said on Thursday it named Matti Kon chief executive officer, chief operating officer and board member, after Bob Oxenberg resigned as interim CEO.
Oxenberg would continue to serve as the company's chairman, Information Management said.

Kon is now president of Blitz Systems Inc, a New York based systems house and technology facility management provider. Under terms of the agreement, Kon would continue to devote a part of his time to Blitz, the company said.
Information Management is in the first year of a multi-year agreement with Blitz Consulting, in which Blitz provides and supports various technology services to the company and its clients.
